description:
Spangdahlem AB is anticipating the solicitation of the potential contract below. Be advised, this is NOT a solicitation, nor does it guarantee a solicitation for this requirement to be posted in the future.

This is an official pre-solicitation, for an anticipated firm-fixed-price contract. 

This is only a pre-solicitation to notify prospective offerors. Quotes are not currently being requested. 

The potential contract is for the purchasing of 30 Thermal Camo Nets IAW Attachement 1 - Salient Characteristics - FA560626QA029 to be delivered to Spangdahlem Air Base, Germany. 

Note: Training on equipment is required.
